events.text:
**Paychecks late.** This week, some direct deposits run through Quillbook payroll arrived hours late, and some employees were paid a day late. Posts are spreading in a bookkeepers' Facebook group and on Reddit. Another payroll provider also reported delays.

Known: no money was lost; Quillbook's engineers are working with its partner bank.
Not known: how many payrolls; whose fault it is; whether it will happen again.

events.text: All late deposits arrived by Saturday morning. The cause was a fault at Quillbook's partner bank in processing payment files, made worse by a slow job in Quillbook's own system that sent some files late. Quillbook has fixed its job. About 1 in 20 payroll customers had at least one employee paid late.

events.text:
**Government shutdown.** Overnight, Congress missed its funding deadline, and parts of the federal government shut down. Some federal workers have been sent home; others, such as air traffic controllers and TSA officers, must keep working without pay. Nobody knows how long it will last.

Known: Social Security payments and the Postal Service continue.
Not known: how long it will last; when federal workers will be paid; which services will slow down.

IRS phone lines are closed and some processing is slower. Small Business Administration loans are paused. Some customers sell to the federal government and may be paid late.
events.title: Government shutdown

original_announcement.title: Government shutdown
original_announcement.body:
**Government shutdown.** Overnight, Congress missed its funding deadline, and parts of the federal government shut down. Some federal workers have been sent home; others, such as air traffic controllers and TSA officers, must keep working without pay. Nobody knows how long it will last.

Known: Social Security payments and the Postal Service continue.
Not known: how long it will last; when federal workers will be paid; which services will slow down.

IRS phone lines are closed and some processing is slower. Small Business Administration loans are paused. Some customers sell to the federal government and may be paid late.

events.exposure_note: Public shutdown report made available to all 24 voices. Initial universal awareness is a model assumption; no firm-level government receivable or SBA exposure is assigned.
events.timing_note: This public shutdown announcement is released in week 7 only. Duration, affected services and federal-worker pay timing are unknown. No reopening is confirmed and no legal deadline extension is established. Individual profiles do not specify federal-vendor status, a pending SBA loan, furloughed staff or an actually overdue federal invoice: discuss those risks conditionally rather than inventing personal impact.

events.title: Government shutdown — update
events.text: The Senate passed a short-term funding bill; the House plans to vote after Christmas. Federal workers have been told they will get back pay once the government reopens. Their December 30 paycheck may be missed.

events.timing_note: Week8 is December21–27. Senate passage is confirmed; the House only plans a vote after Christmas. No government reopening, House passage or restored IRS/SBA services is confirmed. Federal workers were told back pay will come once government reopens; it has not been paid. December30 is in week9 and a missed paycheck is a possibility, not an already observed loss. Do not invent a shutdown end date or Quillbook responsibility for federal wages.
